notifications.deliveriesHint: Recent attempts to deliver reminders and tests.

ai.title: AI assistance
ai.subtitle: Smart Capture and planning suggestions.

ai.enabledHint: Turn off to hide every AI action in TickPoint.

ai.hoursHint: Used when AI plans checkpoints around your schedule.

ai.planningStyleHint: How AI spreads work across the days before a deadline.
ai.usageHint: Requests and tokens from the last 30 days.
ai.usageEmpty: No AI requests in the last 30 days.
ai.privacyBody: Text you paste is sent to Google Gemini only when you click Analyze or Generate. Nothing is sent in the background.
ai.privacyCredentials: Prompts never include your passwords, tokens or account credentials.
ai.privacyDrafts: Every AI result is a draft. Nothing is saved to your tasks until you review and approve it.
ai.privacyDelete: You can delete stored source text and drafts at any time from the source or draft page.

account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends your central Aryuki Accounts session. You will also be signed out of the other Aryuki apps on this browser.

backups.subtitle: Point-in-time copies of your data, kept on the server.

danger.description: Permanently removes your tasks, goals, projects, notes, backups and history from TickPoint. Your Aryuki Accounts sign-in is not affected.
danger.message: This cannot be undone. Export your data first if you want a copy.
